title: allophylus cobbe var. glaber
intro: Allophylus cobbe var. glaber, commonly known as West African almond, is a plant species in the Sapindaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of A. cobbe var. glaber include pain relief, fever reduction, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
